## Frequently asked questions

### What is CRM pricing and how is it determined? What factors affect CRM software cost?

CRM pricing refers to the cost of implementing and using [customer relationship management software](https://web.archive.org/web/20261114225809/https://www.pipedrive.com/en/crm/fundamentals). The price is determined by factors like number of users, features included in the software, integrations and level of support provided by CRM companies.

### How much does a CRM cost on average?

CRM costs vary widely depending on the CRM company and features included. On average, the typical cost of CRM software ranges from less than a hundred to several hundred dollars per user per year, with some enterprise-level solutions costing even more. To find the best CRM software prices, research and compare CRM providers based on their pricing plans and features. Pipedrive offers different solutions at price points to match users’ requirements. Learn more on our [CRM price comparison](https://web.archive.org/web/20261114225809/https://www.pipedrive.com/crm-comparison) pages.

### Can my co-workers join my free trial?

Yes, you can invite as many people as you want to join your Pipedrive trial. Simply click on your profile in the top right corner of your screen and select “Add more users” from the drop-down menu.

### Will my data be safe?

Protecting your business data is one of our highest priorities. Learn more about our rigorous [security and privacy](/web/20261114225809/https://www.pipedrive.com/features/privacy-security) standards.

### What is an add-on?

Add-ons are additional Pipedrive tools that you can add to any plan.

### What’s the difference between annual and monthly billing?

The difference is [how often you pay](https://web.archive.org/web/20261114225809/https://support.pipedrive.com/en/article/what-is-the-difference-between-annual-and-monthly-billing-in-pipedrive) your subscription fee. With monthly billing, you will be charged on the same day each month. With annual billing, you are charged once for the whole year.

### Which payment methods do you accept?

There are [different ways](https://web.archive.org/web/20261114225809/https://support.pipedrive.com/en/article/what-are-the-accepted-payment-methods-for-pipedrive) to pay for Pipedrive including major credit cards, debit cards and PayPal. Your payment options depend on the country you live in.

### How can I contact customer support?

Our friendly support team is ready to help out. [Here’s how to get in touch.](https://web.archive.org/web/20261114225809/https://support.pipedrive.com/en/contact-us)

### What are the prices associated with CRM?

As well as the cost of the customer relationship management software itself, which differs based on pricing tier, some providers also charge users for implementation, setup, training, data migration, support and more. You may also be able to purchase credits to get access to more features or more access to the features already on your plan. Try to find a CRM that’s transparent about its pricing. Pipedrive has no hidden costs, making it an excellent choice for anyone with a fixed budget.

### What does it cost to implement a CRM?

The cost of implementing a CRM varies based on factors such as business size, software choice, user count, customization and integration needs. On-premises setups usually have higher upfront costs. Some CRM providers charge users for implementation. If you choose Pipedrive, implementation is free when you sign up for a pricing plan that’s over $400 a year. Costs differ widely, so a thorough evaluation is essential for an accurate estimate.

## Sales Cloud Pricing FAQ

Sales Cloud offers flexible pricing plans to grow with your business. Choose from Starter Suite, Pro Suite, Core, Advanced, and Max — each with increasing levels of AI, automation, integration, and customization. Want help finding the right fit? ### How does Sales Cloud pricing work?

Sales Cloud pricing follows a per-user, per-month subscription model. You pay a monthly fee for each user who needs access. Pricing varies by edition, with each offering different features and levels of functionality to fit your business needs.

### Is there a free version of Sales Cloud?

Salesforce offers a free 30-day trial for all Sales Cloud editions, with simple setup so you can get started quickly and explore key sales capabilities. If you'd like to explore an all-in-one CRM experience across sales, service, marketing, commerce, and Slack, you can also start a [free 30-day trial of Starter Suite](https://web.archive.org/web/20261010011710/https://www.salesforce.com/small-business/free-trial/starter-suite/?d=pb) for up to 10 users.

It's an all-in-one CRM designed for small businesses, bringing together sales, service, marketing and commerce tools. Plus, it includes Slack at no extra cost for seamless collaboration.

### What is the Sales Cloud Core plan?

Sales Cloud Core is an advanced CRM for sales teams, with built-in AI and automation to help grow revenue faster. We know things don’t always go according to plan, and we’re here and will try our best to support. Reach out to a sales representative at 1-800-664-9073 to discuss options.

### Do Salesforce products integrate with outside applications and systems?

In many cases, Salesforce products integrate directly with many outside applications and systems to help you connect your data. For those that don’t have built-in integration, like on-premises data sources, you can purchase licenses of MuleSoft, work with our integration partners, or use apps on AgentExchange.   
  
Talk to a sales representative to get an idea of what integration solution works best with the Salesforce products you use.

### What support and service packages are available?

We offer several advisory, adoption, and support plans to our customers. To learn more, visit [Success Cloud](https://web.archive.org/web/20261010011710/https://www.salesforce.com/services/).

### How long are your contracts?

Most Salesforce products use annual contracts, but Salesforce subscription terms vary. Chat with a sales representative to discuss payment and billing options for your products.

### Can I upgrade at any time? Can I add more products later on?

You can add products or upgrade at any time, but some products may need to scale together. Reach out to our sales department at 1-800-664-9073 to see what works for your business.

## Team Users: A Quick Overview

### Organization vs. Team levels in Zoho CRM

Data in Zoho CRM is organized into data modules, and your CRM users are granted access to the modules relevant to them. Modules and users are available at two levels — the organization (or org) level, and team level.

### Org modules

contain data closely tied to your sales processes. The users who work on these modules are org users, and they have full-scale CRM access. This license is ideal for sales reps, sales managers, presales teams, and central CRM admins.

Note: Any mention of just "users" in Zoho CRM refers to this type of user.

### Team modules

contain niche data particular to specific teams that support the sales process at various stages. The users who work on these modules are team users. Outside of their team modules, they only have partial access to CRM data and functionality. This license is ideal for all non-sales users, like marketing, support, legal, finance, and others.

Frequently asked questions.
Which plan is right for me?
Our plans are built to scale with your needs. They include all the basic features and become increasingly more powerful depending on which plan you choose. Here's how they break down:
Free (for individuals): This plan is for teams with less than 3 people. It includes all the basic features, but has limited capabilities, including email and data enrichment.
Plus (for single teams): This plan has up to 10 seats. It has enhanced data enrichment, email capabilities such as sending and sharing and enhanced contact analysis.
Pro (for scaling businesses): This plan is for businesses who need a single source of truth across their entire organization. It includes complete email sharing and sending capabilities, advanced data enrichment, advanced access permissions and extensive report building.
Enterprise (for large organizations): This plan includes everything from our Pro plan plus advanced admin tools, permission access and SAML support. It is built for large organizations with strategic relationships spanning multiple business units.
Does Attio have a free trial?
Yes! Attio has a 14-day trial of our Pro plan which you can use to explore whether Attio is right for you.
Is Attio free to use?
Attio has plans for teams of all sizes, including a free option for very small teams or light projects. Our paid plans are incredibly powerful and are the best way to get the most out of Attio.
How do credits work?
Attio has two types of credits that are shared across our AI and workflows features.
Workspace credits: for anyone in the workspace to use on all AI features, including Ask Attio, and workflows
Seat credits: for each seat to use personally on Ask Attio
Every plan includes credits for you to get started, and you can always add more workspace credits as needed.
For more details on how credits work, check out our guide .
Do you offer discounts?
Our Plus and Pro plans come with a 20% discount with annual billing.
What are my payment options?
All payments can be made via credit card. For our Pro and Enterprise plans, we can issue invoices and will accept PO, ACH, check or wire. Please contact our sales team for more information.
Do you offer invoice billing?
We can issue invoices for our users of our Pro and Enterprise plans.
Do I need to connect my email?
Connecting your email and calendar is not required. However, we recommend you sync your email and calendar with Attio.
When you sync your email and calendar, Attio instantly builds a real-time, global database of all your contacts. The more contacts you have in the database, the better our product becomes for you.
Can I import data from other tools?
Yes! You can easily import data into Attio from other applications through CSV files.
Do you have a startup program?
Yes! We offer up to 80% off for eligible startups and you can apply here . For more information on the program feel free to reach out to the team at sales@attio.com .
Do you have monthly and annual billing options?
Our plans are billed either annually or monthly. If you choose to pay annually for our Plus and Pro plans, you'll receive a 20% discount.
Does Attio have an API?
Yes. Attio has a custom API that allows you to integrate with other tools in your stack.

Alongside [Lakebase Postgres](/web/20261116112736/https://neon.com/lakebase), every Neon project can use [Managed Better Auth](/web/20261116112736/https://neon.com/auth), the [Data API](/web/20261116112736/https://neon.com/docs/data-api/get-started), [Object Storage](/web/20261116112736/https://neon.com/object-storage), [Functions](/web/20261116112736/https://neon.com/functions), [AI Gateway](/web/20261116112736/https://neon.com/ai-gateway), and [Realtime](/web/20261116112736/https://neon.com/docs/realtime/overview) (in beta). On Free, AI Gateway needs a card and prepaid credits, and your plan stays Free.

### What is a Neon project?

A [project](/web/20261116112736/https://neon.com/docs/manage/projects) in Neon is the top-level container for your environment. Each project includes all branches, with your Postgres databases and (if you deploy them) your Object Storage buckets, Functions, Managed Better Auth endpoints, and AI Gateway access.

### What is a CU?

A CU (short for Compute Unit) is Neon's way of representing **Postgres database compute size**. Neon databases [autoscale](/web/20261116112736/https://neon.com/docs/introduction/autoscaling), and CUs define how much CPU and memory your database is using at any moment. Each CU allocates approximately 4 GB of RAM, along with associated CPU.

### What is a CU-hour?

A CU-hour is Neon's unit for measuring **Postgres database compute usage**. Because Neon databases scale to zero and autoscale, you're billed only for the database compute resources you actually use. In other words, your monthly database compute usage depends on:

For a single compute, the calculation works like this:

`Monthly CU-hours = [average CU size] × [number of hours the compute runs in the month]`
`Monthly compute cost = [monthly CU-hours] × [CU-hour price]`

Remember that when your database is idle, compute can scale down to zero, so you don't consume CU-hours while it's not running. [Learn more about Neon's billing.](/web/20261116112736/https://neon.com/docs/introduction/about-billing)

### Does Neon pause Free plan projects when they are inactive?

No. Neon doesn't pause Free projects for inactivity, and there's no restore step. Your project, data, and connection string stay the same.

Compute is suspended only if a project uses up its monthly 100 CU-hours or 5 GB of network transfer. It resumes at the start of the next billing period, or as soon as you upgrade. ### How are the backend services billed?

Object Storage, Functions, and AI Gateway are billed separately from Postgres compute (CU-hours). Managed Better Auth, the Data API, and Realtime have no separate charge.

**Realtime** is free during the beta. Database compute and network transfer it generates are billed as usual.

**Object Storage** is $0.023 per GB-month of stored volume. There's no per-operation charge. Egress counts toward your public network transfer allowance. The Free plan includes 5 GB of Object Storage per project.

**Functions** are billed for active compute, waiting compute, and invocations at the rates in the plan table. The Free plan includes 10 active capacity-hours, 400 waiting capacity-hours, and 1 million invocations per project per month.

**AI Gateway** is available on every plan, including Free. Pricing matches the model provider's list prices, with no markup, and draws down prepaid credits. On Free, add a card to buy credits. ### Can I use AI Gateway on the Free plan?

Yes. Add a card on the **Billing** page in the Neon Console and buy prepaid AI Gateway credits ($5 minimum). Your organization stays on the Free plan, and the rest of your Free plan doesn't change. AI Gateway turns on after your first purchase, once a short account check finishes. Requests draw down your credits at the model provider's list prices, with no markup. [Learn how prepaid credits work.](/web/20261116112736/https://neon.com/docs/ai-gateway/prepaid-credits)

### How much network transfer (egress) is included?

Public network transfer is counted per project, not per account:

Each project's allowance is shared by everything in it: Postgres, Object Storage, and Functions. Eligible startups can apply for up to $100k in credits through the [Startup Program](/web/20261116112736/https://neon.com/startups). [Learn how to reduce network transfer.](/web/20261116112736/https://neon.com/docs/introduction/network-transfer)

### How do Neon costs scale as I add projects or traffic?

With usage, not with instance size or project count. There's no per-project or per-database fee: each project pays for the compute it actually runs (CU-hours) and the storage it holds.

This makes Neon cost-efficient for many small databases, such as a database per tenant or per agent, and for intermittent or spiky workloads.

### How much does a database per tenant or per agent cost on Neon?

Neon's pricing is built for this pattern. Each tenant gets its own project, an isolated Postgres database with its own compute, and there's no per-project or per-database fee:

For example, 100 tenant databases on Launch, each running at 0.25 CU for about an hour a day and storing 150 MB, use about 750 CU-hours and 15 GB of storage: roughly $85 a month in total, or about $0.85 per tenant.

Platforms that provision databases for their users at scale can apply to the [Agent Plan](/web/20261116112736/https://neon.com/programs/agents). For design guidance, see [Multitenancy with Neon](/web/20261116112736/https://neon.com/docs/guides/multitenancy).

### What does "no monthly minimum" mean on paid plans?

Neon's paid plans don't require a minimum monthly spend or base fee. You're billed purely based on usage. If one month you barely use Neon, your bill might be just a few dollars.

For example, if your databases are mostly idle that month, or you only run them briefly for development or testing, you'll only pay for the compute and storage actually consumed during that time. Remember that Neon databases scale to zero by default.

### Are the Free plan quotas for database usage included in the paid plans?

No. When you're on a paid plan, database usage starts metering from zero for both compute and storage. Free plan quotas don't apply once you upgrade. Instead, you're billed purely based on actual usage, at the rates of your paid plan.

You should consider a paid plan if:

If your usage fits comfortably within the Free plan and you're not running a production workload, there's no reason to upgrade. The Free plan is designed to be genuinely useful for development and prototyping. [Learn more about our Free plan philosophy.](/web/20261116112736/https://neon.com/blog/why-so-many-projects-in-the-neon-free-plan)

### How is Postgres database storage billed in Neon?

In Neon, you don't provision or manage database storage in advance. It scales automatically and invisibly as your data grows. At the end of each month, you're billed for the database storage actually consumed per project, measured in GB-months.

Neon bills storage usage using two separate metrics:

**History storage (or instant restore storage)**

**Instant restore** relies on Neon retaining a history of database changes so you can restore a branch to a previous point in time, create branches from past states, run Time Travel queries, and more. How long that history is kept is controlled by the **history window** on **Settings → Instant restore** (1 day by default on paid plans). See [History window](/web/20261116112736/https://neon.com/docs/introduction/history-window).

**History** storage is billed based on the amount of Write-Ahead Log (WAL) retained within that history window, at $0.20 per GB-month on paid plans. This is billed separately from your regular database storage.

If you don't need deep recovery or long Time Travel, shorten the history window to reduce costs.

**Database storage (root and child branches)**

This is the storage used by your database data itself. Since Neon databases can branch, this is how branches contribute to database storage:

The sum of both components will be billed as your database storage at $0.35 per GB-month.

What this implies:

To keep database storage costs low, keep child branches short-lived: set [expiration times](/web/20261116112736/https://neon.com/docs/guides/branch-expiration), [reset them](/web/20261116112736/https://neon.com/docs/guides/reset-from-parent) frequently, or delete branches when they're no longer needed.

### How are extra branches billed?

Each paid plan includes a set number of branches per project at no additional cost (10 branches per project on Launch, 25 branches per project on Scale). You can create and delete branches freely within that allowance:

Example: The Launch plan includes 10 branches per project. If you already have 10 branches but create 2 additional branches and keep them for 5 hours each, that'd be 10 extra branch-hours total: 10 × $0.002/hour = $0.02

**How to avoid extra branch charges**

### How can I control my Postgres database costs (compute and storage consumption)?

Database compute is often the most variable part of a monthly bill. For Neon databases, the most effective way to control compute costs is to configure maximum autoscaling limits and scale-to-zero.

Autoscaling limits act as a built-in cost ceiling: your database will never scale beyond the limit you set, even during traffic spikes. If you want to prioritize performance over costs in a particular compute endpoint (e.g. production), choose a higher limit. If you want to optimize for cost predictability, set a lower one. [Learn how to configure autoscaling limits.](/web/20261116112736/https://neon.com/docs/guides/autoscaling-guide#configure-autoscaling-defaults-for-your-project)

Another effective way to control database compute costs is to ensure scale to zero is enabled for all non-production branches. When a branch is idle, compute scales down automatically, so you don't pay for compute while it's idle. [Learn about scale to zero.](/web/20261116112736/https://neon.com/docs/introduction/scale-to-zero)

To manage database storage costs, regularly clean up unused branches, snapshots, and projects, and avoid retaining a large history window for instant restore if your use case does not require it. [Learn more about optimizing storage usage.](/web/20261116112736/https://neon.com/docs/introduction/cost-optimization#storage-root-and-child-branches)

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How does billing work?

Render charges for three things: your workspace plan (flat subscription), metered features like bandwidth (usage-based), and [compute](https://web.archive.org/web/20261117034216/https://render.com/pricing#compute) for your applications (usage-based).

### How am I billed for compute?

[Compute plans](https://web.archive.org/web/20261117034216/https://render.com/pricing#compute) are set at a per-service basis, and billing is prorated to the second. If you create a web service on a paid compute plan and turn it off 24 hours later, you are only billed for 24 hours of compute. This also applies to service types that spin up and shut down automatically, like Cron Jobs and Workflows. You are only billed for compute when these services are actively running your workload.

### My Pro or Scale workspace did not have any activity or services this month. Will I still be charged for the workspace subscription?

If a workspace has no services (live or suspended) and no activity during a month, the workspace subscription fee for that month will be waived.

### I run a large agency with developers on multiple teams. What does this mean for us?

Scale and Enterprise plans let you create multiple workspaces within the same organization to better manage multiple teams. Our team is happy to help you determine the best way to organize your teams on Render. [Contact us](https://web.archive.org/web/20261117034216/https://render.com/contact) here.

### What are build pipeline minutes, and how can I track my usage?

Your workspace's builds and other pre-deploy tasks use Render compute resources. [Pipeline minutes](https://web.archive.org/web/20261117034216/https://docs.render.com/build-pipeline#pipeline-minutes) track the duration of these tasks. You can view your pipeline usage from your dashboard's Billing page.

With a Professional plan or higher, you can enable the [Performance pipeline](https://web.archive.org/web/20261117034216/https://docs.render.com/build-pipeline#pipeline-tiers) to run builds on larger compute instances, with an additional corresponding charge for pipeline minutes.

### How do free compute plans work?

With Render’s [Free compute plans](https://web.archive.org/web/20261117034216/https://render.com/docs/free), you can spin up [web services](https://web.archive.org/web/20261117034216/https://docs.render.com/free#free-web-services), [Render Key Value instances](https://web.archive.org/web/20261117034216/https://docs.render.com/free#free-key-value), and [Render Postgres databases](https://web.archive.org/web/20261117034216/https://render.com/docs/free#free-postgres) at no charge. Free compute plans types have usage limits and are designed to help you to explore new tech, build personal projects, and preview Render's developer experience.

### Which payment methods do you accept?

We accept all major credit and debit cards. Your payment info is stored and processed securely by [Stripe](https://web.archive.org/web/20261117034216/https://stripe.com/) and never touches our servers.

### Why was I charged $1 after adding a credit card?

A $1 USD transaction is performed as a credit security check to ensure your card details are correct and authorized. The charge is refunded after the transaction completes.

### We are migrating infrastructure from another provider. Can Render provide professional services to handle the migration?

Render does not offer full migration professional services. However, you can find a certified solution partner through our [expert network](https://web.archive.org/web/20261117034216/https://render.com/experts).

### I have an infrequently asked question.

Great! We're always around to help. You can email us any time at [support@render.com](https://web.archive.org/web/20261117034216/mailto:support@render.com), or talk to us in our [user community](https://web.archive.org/web/20261117034216/https://community.render.com/).
